Delivery Policy

1. Processing Time

Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days after payment confirmation. During high-volume periods or promotions, processing may take up to 3 business days.

2. Delivery Methods and Timeframes

We offer multiple delivery options to meet your needs:

  • Standard Delivery: 3-7 business days
  • Express Delivery: 2-3 business days
  • Priority Delivery: 1-2 business days

Delivery timeframes are estimates and begin from the date of shipment, not the order date. Delivery times may vary based on your location, delivery carrier conditions, and other factors beyond our control.

3. Delivery Costs

Delivery costs are calculated based on the method selected, the weight and dimensions of the products, and the delivery destination. The exact delivery cost will be displayed during checkout before payment.

Free standard delivery is available for orders over $50 within the continental United States.

4. International Delivery

We deliver to many countries worldwide. International orders may be subject to import duties, taxes, and customs fees, which are the responsibility of the recipient. Please check your country's customs policies before placing an order.

International delivery typically takes 7-21 business days, depending on the destination country, customs processing, and local delivery conditions.

5. Order Tracking

Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing a tracking number. You can use this number to track your package's journey through our website or directly through the carrier's website.

6. Delivery Restrictions

Some products may not be eligible for international delivery due to local regulations or delivery carrier restrictions. If you have questions about shipping a specific item to your location, please contact our customer service team before placing your order.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our delivery policy, please contact us at:

Email: delivery@iibsy.com
Phone: +252 (63) 673-0837

Last updated: April 26, 2025
